description:
SQLite had several UAT failures and timeouts in TPC-H-source workloads, TPC-DS
OBT exited 137, and some cells returned passed status while query-level
failures were present. This should be separated from the shared partial-success
status contract because SQLite also has platform-specific performance and
compatibility behavior to classify.

anti_patterns.dont: mask SQLite query failures as successful benchmark cells
anti_patterns.why: Explorer publication depends on honest status.

preserves.behavior: SQLite adapter remains dependency-light and local-only.
Shared status-contract fixes are not duplicated in SQLite-specific code.
